text:
STAGE  1  :  TOKENIZER  
Input:   Apple  is  a  fruit  
Tokenize:   ["apple",  "is",  "a",  "fruit"]  
Convert  to  IDs:   [15,  22,  8,  90]  
Output:   token_ids  
 
STAGE  2  :  EMBEDDINGS  
Every  token  becomes  a  vector.  
Example:  
apple  ->  [0.2,  0.8,  0.4]  
is     ->  [0.1,  0.5,  0.7]  
Embedding  Matrix:  Vocab  Size  ×  Embedding  Dimension   (10000  ×  512)  
Example:   embedding_matrix[15]  
Returns:   [0.2,0.8,0.4...]  
 
STAGE  3  :  POSITIONAL  EMBEDDINGS

STAGE  3  :  POSITIONAL  EMBEDDINGS  
Transformer  doesn't  know  order.  
Apple  eats  dog  
Dog  eats  apple  
Without  position:   same  tokens  
So  add  position  information.

Position  Matrix:  512  ×  512  
Example:  
final_embedding  =  
token_embedding  +  
Position_embedding;  
 
 
 
STAGE  4  :  SELF  ATTENTION  
This  is  the  brain.  
Input:   The  cat  drank  milk  because  it  was  hungry.  
Question:   What  is  "it"  ?  
Attention  learns:  
it  →  cat  
 
Step  1  
Create  
Q  
K  
V  
Matrices.  
Q  =  XWq  
K  =  XWk

V  =  XWv  
 
Step  2  
Similarity  
Q  ×  Kᵀ  
Example:  
cat  ->  0.9  
milk  ->  0.2  
hungry  ->  0.7  
 
Step  3  
Softmax  
Attention  =  
softmax(QKᵀ  /  √dk)  
 
Step  4  
Output  
Attention  @  V

STAGE  5  :  MULTI  HEAD  ATTENTION  
Instead  of  one  attention:  
Head1  ->  Grammar  
Head2  ->  Context  
Head3  ->  Subject  
Head4  ->  Object  
Example:  8  heads  
Output:  Concat(heads)  
Then:  Linear  Layer  
 
 
STAGE  6  :  ADD  &  NORM  
Transformer  Block  
Attention+Skip  Connection+LayerNorm  
x  =  x  +  attention  
x  =  layernorm(x)

STAGE  7  :  FEED  FORWARD  NETWORK  
Every  token  independently  passes  through:  
Linear  
    |  
ReLU  
    |  
Linear  
 
W1  =  Expand  knowledge  
W2  =  Compress  knowledge  
or  
W1  =  Learn  features  
W2  =  Combine  features  
 
Formula:  FFN(x)=W2(ReLU(W1x+b1))+b2  
 
Example:  
512  
↓  
2048  
↓  
512

STAGE  8  :  TRANSFORMER  BLOCK  
One  encoder  block:  
Input  ↓  Attention  ↓  Add  &  Norm  ↓  Feed  Forward  ↓  Add  &  Norm  
Architecture:  
┌─────────────┐  │  Attention                    │  └──────┬──────┘                    │           Add  &  Norm                    │  ┌──────▼──────┐  │  FeedForward             │  └──────┬──────┘                    │            Add  &  Norm                    │

Output             
STAGE  9  :  STACK  BLOCKS  
Real  LLM:  
Block  1  Block  2  Block  3  ...  Block  N  
 
 
STAGE  10  :  PRETRAINING  
This  is  where  the  model  learns  language.  
BERT  (Masked  LM)  
Input:   Apple  is  a  [MASK]  
Target:   fruit

STAGE  11  :  LOSS  
Model  predicts:  [0.01,0.02,0.80,0.17]  
Target:  fruit  
Cross  Entropy:  
loss  =  CrossEntropy(pred,target)   
STAGE  12  :  BACKPROPAGATION  
Calculate  gradients:  dLoss/dW  
Update:  W  =  W  -  lr*gradient  
Optimizer:  AdamW  
 
STAGE  13  :  TEXT  GENERATION  
After  training:  
Input:   Apple  is  a  
Model:  fruit  
Next:  that  
Next:  grows  
Next:  on  
Next:  trees  
Loop:  
while  not  stop:     predict_next_token()     append_token()  Text

↓  Tokenizer   ↓  Token  IDs   ↓  Embedding   ↓  Position  Embedding   ↓  Transformer  Block  1   ↓  Transformer  Block  2   ↓  Transformer  Block  3                      ↓  ...   ↓  Transformer  Block  N   ↓  Linear  Layer   ↓  Softmax   ↓  Next  Token  Prediction   ↓  Generated  Text
